sources.entry: Story Skills by Daniel Dewhurst - Skills for planning and drafting fiction as markdown with YAML frontmatter: story bible, characters, worldbuilding, arcs, scenes, and chapters. Includes a dependency-free CLI whose continuity checker flags characters appearing after their death, payoffs placed before their setup, and stale story state.

summary.one_liner: Story Skills is a markdown-with-YAML-frontmatter project format and set of agent skills for planning and drafting fiction, plus an optional dependency-free `story` CLI whose continuity checker flags contradictions in the story bible.
summary.what_it_does: It defines a shared project layout for fiction covering the story bible (story.md), characters, worldbuilding, plot arcs, scenes, continuity state, promises and payoffs, and chapter drafts, all as plain markdown files with YAML frontmatter. The README describes 24 skills, packaged as Agent Skills and as Codex and Claude Code plugins, that handle work from premise testing through drafting, revision, line editing, and submission materials. The companion `story` CLI (Node 18+, no runtime dependencies) validates projects, checks links, and runs a continuity engine that reports dead characters appearing later, payoffs placed before their setup, and stale state. It also handles renaming entities, word counts, context packing for chapters, prose linting, manuscript export, and builds to EPUB, DOCX, HTML review copy, print interior, screenplay, Twine, and ink formats. The README also describes GitHub Actions templates that run continuity checks on pull requests and can draft chapters on a schedule.
use_cases: plan a novel or short story in markdown files
check a manuscript for continuity errors
track character deaths, promises, and object state across chapters
import an existing draft and organize it into a project
build EPUB, DOCX, or print interiors from one story project
draft and revise chapters with an AI agent
how_to_run: /plugin marketplace add danjdewhurst/story-skills (inside a Claude Code session)
npx skills add danjdewhurst/story-skills (any agent that supports SKILL.md)
stack: Paged.js, WeasyPrint, or Prince (optional for print PDF)
notable: Continuity engine reports findings like a compiler, with file names and reproducible output; CI asserts the output on every commit
Plain markdown and YAML frontmatter, so projects diff, branch, and open in any editor
Builds for many formats from one project, including right-to-left scripts and vertical Chinese, Japanese, and Korean text
Exemptions file for dismissing findings and a chapter `mentions` field for intentional flashbacks or posthumous appearances
GitHub Actions templates that draft chapters on a schedule within budgets and open pull requests for review
caveats: GitHub Pages review copies are public unless your plan supports private Pages; private manuscripts need the separate guidance in the README
Drafting workflow requires an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret
Entity names in scripts with no transliteration (e.g. 李明) need an explicit id via `story add --id`
Standalone binaries are attached to releases only after version 0.17.0
